app.name: Dashtaube
app.tagline: All your AI notifications in one place.
login.title: Sign in
login.hint: You set the password as ADMIN_PASSWORD during setup.
list.empty: Nothing here right now. Nice and quiet.
detail.none: Pick a notification. Use j and k to move through the list.
sources.title: Sources
sources.intro: Each source has its own token that it uses to send notifications. AIs like ChatGPT connect via MCP and show up here automatically.
sources.name: Name
sources.secretOnce: Copy this now. Dashtaube shows it only once.
sources.rotateConfirm: Create a new token? The old one stops working immediately.
sources.deleteConfirm: Delete source “{name}” and all its notifications?
sources.disconnectConfirm: Disconnect “{name}”? The AI will have to connect again.
sources.mcpText: Add this URL as an MCP server in ChatGPT (Settings → Apps & Connectors) or Claude (Settings → Connectors). Dashtaube will ask you whether the AI may send notifications.
shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.list: j / k: next / previous · Enter: open · e: done · y: archive · s: snooze · u: unread · /: search · Esc: close · ?: help
